added: Re-import choreography can now take a Caller's Box or ContraDB link or ID number, so a dance whose title is spelled differently at the source (A-1 Reel against your A1 Reel) can still be refreshed.

When an imported dance may be one you already have under a differently written title (A-1 Reel {variant} against your A1 Reel (Imp Var), by the same choreographer), the import review and single-dance online import offer to replace that dance. Nothing is replaced unless you choose it.
changed: When Re-import choreography cannot reach a source, or the dance does not exist there, it now says which, instead of a general "could not load" message.
Re-import choreography now refuses a dance that arrives without any figures (The Caller's Box withholds them for some dances), instead of replacing your figures with an empty list.

added: `DedupeVerdict.possibleMatchIds`, filled by `DedupeIndex.possibleTitleMatches` on `isNew` and `ambiguous` verdicts: existing dances with the same `dedupeCoreTitleKey` (trailing `{…}`/`(…)`/`[…]` annotations dropped unless the rest is a placeholder title such as `New Dance`; `A-1` read as `a1`) and a shared author, but a different `normalizeTitle`. It never changes a verdict's kind or candidates and is never confident. `normalizeTitle` is unchanged.
